metadata.title: Lapatinib and Capecitabine Therapy - 21 days
metadata.indication: HER2-positive advanced or metastatic breast cancer after prior anthracycline, taxane and trastuzumab therapy, in accordance with the NCCP indication.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

metadata.source_version_verification_method: manual comparison with current official NCCP PDF header and version-control information
metadata.legacy_internal_id_note: Stable internal ID retained to avoid breaking existing bookmarks and catalogue references; display metadata now records the explicit NCCP source version.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Source audit and scenario cases in validation/breast-expansion-v08416/advanced. Not clinical approval.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade
diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools per day above the patient's baseline, assess ostomy output, continence, hydration, fever, abdominal pain, haemodynamic compromise and whether hospital care is indicated.
diarrhoea_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP tables use CTCAE4.0. Confirm the named source toxicity grade; do not substitute stool-count cutoffs from a different CTCAE edition.

hand_foot_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia grade
hand_foot_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess painful erythema, swelling, hyperkeratosis, peeling or blistering of palms/soles and the effect on instrumental or self-care activities. This toxicity has grades0–3; no grade4 HFS option.

other_toxicity_grade.label: Other treatment-related toxicity grade
other_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the actual adverse event first, then apply that toxicity-specific CTCAE definition. The generic severity anchors are not a substitute for the named CTCAE criterion.
other_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP tables use CTCAE4.0. Confirm the named source toxicity grade; do not substitute stool-count cutoffs from a different CTCAE edition.

alt_grade.label: Legacy ALT/AST elevation grade (use measured result)
alt_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured ALT/AST and laboratory ULN; account for an abnormal baseline where CTCAE specifies a baseline-relative definition. Assess bilirubin and alternative causes concurrently.

bilirubin_grade.label: Legacy Bilirubin elevation grade (use measured result)
bilirubin_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the measured bilirubin and laboratory ULN; account for an abnormal baseline where CTCAE specifies a baseline-relative definition and assess the overall hepatic pattern.

severe_lapatinib_hepatotoxicity.label: Severe liver toxicity attributed to lapatinib

renal_input.reason: NCCP capecitabine thresholds use creatinine clearance in mL/min. Confirm the method; indexed eGFR is not directly interchangeable, and conflicting band/numeric results require review.

lvef_below_local_lln.label: Current LVEF below institutional lower limit of normal

cardiac_toxicity_grade.label: Symptoms related to decreased LVEF
cardiac_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: The regimen gives treatment-action thresholds, not a complete grading table. Confirm the exact adverse event and its clinician-assessed grade; do not infer severity from a single symptom or LVEF value.
cardiac_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm the named adverse event and grading criteria with the treating team before applying the source treatment-action threshold.

qtc_prolonged.label: QTc prolongation confirmed on clinical review

diarrhoea_complicating_features.label: Diarrhoea with dehydration, fever/sepsis, bleeding, neutropenia, marked cramps or other complicating features

pulmonary_toxicity_grade.label: Pulmonary toxicity grade
pulmonary_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: The regimen gives treatment-action thresholds, not a complete grading table. Confirm the exact adverse event and its clinician-assessed grade; do not infer severity from a single symptom or LVEF value.
pulmonary_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm the named adverse event and grading criteria with the treating team before applying the source treatment-action threshold.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic impairment needs consultant/pharmacy dose selection. NCCP table lists 750 mg daily for HER2-positive metastatic disease and 1000 mg for hormone-receptor/HER2-positive disease; the table spans other lapatinib combinations. Do not choose by HR status alone or automatically apply another combination dose.

action.recommendation: Confirm creatinine clearance in mL/min for the NCCP renal bands. Indexed eGFR must not be directly substituted; do not calculate a capecitabine dose from an unconfirmed result.

action.recommendation: NCCP00217 specifies 75% of original capecitabine dose for CrCl 30–50 mL/min, including this 1000 mg/m²twice-daily regimen. Verify creatinine clearance method, actual prescription and other reductions; do not substitute a generic capecitabine rule.

action.recommendation: Stop lapatinib for at least 2 weeks for symptomatic decreased LVEF grade≥3 or LVEF below institutional lower limit. May restart at 1000 mg/day with capecitabine only if LVEF normalises and patient asymptomatic after specialist review. Not an automatic restart.

action.recommendation: Interpret current LVEF against the institutional lower limit and symptoms; this source does not establish a universal 50% cutoff. Confirm whether below local normal before deciding. Baseline LVEF required for all patients under NCCP cardiac-complications section.

action.recommendation: Review QTc using the ECG report, correction method, clinical risk and interacting medicines. NCCP/SmPC do not specify a 450 ms contraindication for lapatinib. Obtain baseline and week 1–2 ECG (EMA SmPC), correct potassium/magnesium and agree any interruption.

summary: Both agents minimal-to-low emetic risk; individual PRN antiemetic and QT/interaction review.
No routine infusion premedication. Provide diarrhoea and hand-foot instructions and oral treatment calendar.

administration.notes: Once daily continuously; meal timing consistent, at least 1 h before/after food. No split dose.
